about.greeting: Hi! I am a Full-Stack developer focused on Back-end, nearing graduation in Internet Systems and a graduate in Electrotechnics from IFMA Campus Timon.
about.journey: My programming foundation started with Python, where I developed a solid logic that I now apply to the Node.js ecosystem. I specialize in building APIs and scalable systems using TypeScript, NestJS, AdonisJS, and PostgreSQL, always focusing on best practices and organization via Docker. Professionally, I stood out in the Developer Community, where I worked on pilot projects and management assistance, and at ATI Timon, where I delivered the informative portal for the SEI system.
about.objective: I am seeking opportunities that allow me to apply my technical skills and grow professionally, contributing to challenging projects. My goal is to continue evolving in the development of complex solutions, always focused on performance, transparency, and innovation.

cards.title: Junior Full Stack Developer
cards.content: Non-profit developer community that carries out the development of real projects with the most modern tools on the market. I contribute to the development of web platforms and RESTful APIs, actively participating in all phases of the software development cycle, from conception to implementation and maintenance.
cards.footer: Technologies: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Docker, NestJS

cards.title: Junior Web Developer
cards.content: Agency responsible for modernizing public management and driving digital transformation in the municipality, being the developer of the Conecta Timon app, which integrates over 200 municipal services for citizens. I worked on the web development team, contributing to the development of the SEI portal (Electronic Information System) with WordPress and Elementor tools.

cards.title: Business and Management Event Monitor
cards.description: Federal Institute of Maranhão (IFMA) - Timon Campus
cards.content: I worked as a monitor at the 1st Business and Management Colloquium at IFMA, assisting in the organization, coordination and support during activities. My responsibilities included helping with event logistics, ensuring the smooth running of sessions and providing support to participants and speakers.
cards.footer: Skills Developed: Event Organization, Communication, Teamwork

cards.title: IFReserve
cards.content: Project completed for my thesis with the aim of building a suggestive application for implementing new features in the SUAP system at IFMA Timon Campus. With a grade of 8.8/10, IFReserve is a sports court reservation system that allows users to book time slots for court usage in a practical and efficient way.

cards.title: Recipe List
cards.content: Mobile application that allows users to explore a variety of culinary recipes from the DummyJSON API. Users can browse through different recipe categories, view complete details including ingredients and preparation instructions, and save their favorite recipes for quick access.

cards.title: Any Recipe
cards.content: System for registering and viewing culinary recipes. Users can create an account, log in, register new recipes with details such as ingredients and instructions, and view a list of all registered recipes. The application offers a user-friendly interface to facilitate navigation and recipe management.

cards.title: Product E-commerce
cards.content: E-commerce platform developed for selling various products. The application allows users to browse through different product categories, view complete details, add items to the shopping cart, and complete purchases securely. The system also includes administrative functionalities to manage the product catalog, orders, and users.
